name: goalcraft
description: Convert raw requirements into goal-optimized prompts for Claude Code or Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Turn requirements into goal-optimized agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Convert raw feature requirements, bug reports, or rough task descriptions into a goal-optimized prompt for the coding agent that will run it — Claude Code or Codex. Executor-adaptive; asks for missing done-criteria/scope before producing a copy-paste prompt; uses /goal for long-horizon work.
defaultPrompt: 이 요구사항을 코딩 에이전트용 goal 프롬프트로 변환해줘.
Turn this into a Codex prompt.
대시보드 빠르게 해달라는 걸 제대로 된 goal 프롬프트로 만들어줘.
